description: Update rules of the project, checked by S23 (tests/static/s23-renovate.sh). Same base as CELIAN, the generator of this project.

regex.description: The installer of the test tools, tests/tools/install.sh, lives under tests/, which config:recommended hides from every manager (preset :ignoreModulesAndTests, **/tests/**). For the regex managers only, the same list without **/tests/**: Renovate replaces ignorePaths, it does not merge it. None of the files of the other regex managers lives under tests/.

customManagers.description: Container images pinned by tag and digest in workflow env vars ending in _IMAGE

Task, conftest, OpenTofu and Trivy, pinned in tests/tools/install.sh, and kind, pinned in local/scripts/lib/preflight-checks.sh, each version under a # renovate: comment. kind moves with its node image, in the group of the packageRules below. Renovate cannot update tests/tools/SHA256SUMS: its lines for the new version are written by hand in the same PR, from the checksum file of the release. Until then install.sh finds no sum for the new archives, and the CI of the PR fails.

Images of the local layer, by tag and digest under a # renovate: comment: the node image of local/kind/cluster.yaml, under the key image; in local/tasks/local.yml the zot mirror, under MIRROR_IMAGE, and the controller of Envoy Gateway and the OCI artifacts of its two charts, under ENVOY_GATEWAY_*_IMAGE; the images of the manifests of local/data/ (Postgres and the cache) and the proxy of Envoy Gateway of local/platform/envoy-proxy.yaml, under the key image; Renovate follows the digest of the proxy tag, which docker versioning cannot order, and the tag moves by hand with Envoy Gateway (ADR-004, version rule; ADR-005, updates; ADR-011, condition 8; ADR-012, condition 5; ADR-015, condition 2; ADR-016).

packageRules.description: ADR-012, condition 5: Postgres stays on the major of platform.yaml, the default major of Cloud SQL. Another major goes by hand, in a release that passes the whole matrix.
ADR-004, version rule, point 5: the node image stays on the Kubernetes minor of platform.yaml. The minor changes by hand.

ADR-015, conditions 2, 9 and 16: the cache image stays on the patches of the cache_engine_line of platform.yaml, the line that the managed cache of GCP serves by default, in the Alpine variant alone. The line moves by hand with platform.yaml.
ADR-004, version rule, point 5: kind and its node image move in one PR. Renovate cannot refuse a PR that holds only one of them: complete it by hand before merging.
ADR-005, updates, point 2: the charts and the controller image of Envoy Gateway move in one PR. Renovate ignores vendor folders: the vendored render and its sums are redone by hand in the same PR.

Principle VI of CELIAN, ADR-016: these registries give Renovate no release date, so it cannot count the 7 days. Each update waits on the Dependency Dashboard: a person who maintains the project ticks it, never an agent, once the upstream release of the proposed digest is 7 days old, or at once for the fix of a published advisory.
